name: create-my-maps
description: Turn data into colored maps of 463 countries, states, districts and constituencies, and get a link that opens the finished, editable map on createmymaps.com.

interface.longDescription: Ask for a map in plain words, such as "map India's population by state" or "color the 2024 US election by winner". The assistant picks the right map from 463 (the world, continents, countries, US states and counties, Indian states and constituencies, and more), matches your data to the exact regions, and returns a link that opens the finished map on createmymaps.com, ready to edit and export as PNG, SVG or PDF.
capabilities: Color a map of the world, a continent, a country, US states or counties, or Indian states and constituencies
Match your region names or ids to the exact regions of one of 463 maps
Shade regions by a numeric value with a light-to-dark gradient and a legend
Color regions by category, such as election winner, party or status
Apply threshold rules, such as above 50 percent is green and below is red
Set a title, legend heading, description, data source line and region labels
Print up to three insight callouts on the map, each pointing at its region, plus marker pins
Return a link that opens the finished map on createmymaps.com, ready to edit
Export the finished map as PNG, SVG or PDF from createmymaps.com
Produce an import file for very large maps with hundreds of regions
defaultPrompt: Color a world map by GDP per capita
Make a US map of the 2024 election results

publication.release_notes: Insight callouts and pins on the map (notes= and pins= in the link), placed by the app beside the region they describe. 463 maps, four coloring styles, several cited sources per map.
